name: Rasam
description: Thin peppery tamarind broth — drunk from the bowl, or poured over rice.

tcm.note: Black pepper and garlic in a thin broth — a warming, surface-releasing soup.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and tikshna; the household remedy given at the first sign of a cold.

unani.note: Garam-khushk, and taken exactly for that reason when someone is chilled.

histamine.note: Tamarind base; the pepper and chilli add irritation independent of histamine.
